[[File:Training_Real_Madrid_in_Amsterdam,_trainer_Munoz_(kop).jpg|thumb|upright|[[Miguel Muñoz]] won La Liga a record nine times]]
This is a '''list of [[La Liga]] winning football managers'''.

[[Miguel Muñoz]] has won the tournament on a record nine occasions, all with [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]. [[Helenio Herrera]] and [[Johan Cruyff]] have each won the title on four occasions.
